title: Sunburst over the treeline
description: Late-day sun flares over a dense green treeline, with a single house visible in a clearing beyond the pines.

title: House in the clearing
description: A wooded suburban lot from above: a long driveway cuts through the pines to a house set in a mown clearing, sun breaking through scattered cloud.

title: Summer canopy and rooftops
description: Rolling hardwood canopy in full summer green, rooftops tucked into the trees and a low band of cumulus on the far horizon.

title: Blue lake beyond the meadow
description: A deep blue lake ringed by pine and hardwood, with a dirt track running down through an open green meadow in the foreground.

title: Resort bay and breakwater
description: A Caribbean resort bay from altitude: white low-rise buildings and a curved pool along the sand, a rock breakwater sheltering pale turquoise shallows against deep open blue.

title: Granite outcrop at golden hour
description: Low orbit over a bare granite outcrop streaked with lichen, a lone figure standing at its center and unbroken forest running to the horizon in the evening light.

title: Pine lake and meadow
description: Slow push out over a grassy meadow and dirt track toward a lake held in pine woods, fair-weather cumulus stacked overhead.

title: Forest lake panorama
description: A wide, steady pass above a forest-rimmed lake, its dark water reflecting the sky as wooded ridges roll away toward distant rooftops.

title: Lake and rolling woodland
description: High flyover of a lake set in deep woodland, with a neighborhood visible along the far ridgeline under a bright, cloud-dotted sky.

title: Resort pool in morning sun
description: Morning sun sits low over a large resort pool, palms throwing long shadows across the deck as the camera drifts out toward the sea.

title: Turquoise cove and palms
description: Slow-motion glide past palm crowns into a sheltered turquoise cove, white villas lining the sand and a swim line marking the calm water.

title: Surf on the rocky shoreline
description: Slow-motion run along a rugged shoreline where surf breaks white over black rock, a stone seawall and palm-lined path separating it from the resort grounds.

title: Poolside peninsula
description: Slow-motion pull back from a resort pool and thatched umbrellas across a low peninsula, deep blue water stretching to a hazy headland.

title: Domed resort and curved pool
description: Slow-motion sweep across a domed white resort building and its curving turquoise pool, then out over open ocean toward green hills.

title: Rocky point and hillside resort
description: Slow-motion arc around a rocky point where waves wash the shelf below a clock-towered resort building, forested hills rising behind.

title: Umbrella-lined pool and coastline
description: Slow-motion hold above rows of thatched umbrellas and a broad turquoise pool, the coastline curving away into blue haze.
